ApplyDamageDialog.Name: Open Apply Damage dialog
ApplyDamageDialog.Hint: When the Apply Damage dialog opens without holding Shift. Holding Shift does the opposite.

ApplyDamageRules.Name: Apply Damage dialog: v14 damage rules
ApplyDamageRules.Hint: In the Apply Damage dialog: apply energy vulnerabilities (+50%), make precision, area and nonlethal immunity work on mixed damage, and use only the largest DR instead of stacking them.

AutoPrice.Label: Auto Price
AutoPrice.Hint: Calculate the price from the base price, masterwork, enhancement bonus and modifications. The Price field then holds the mundane base price.

Modifications.Label: Modifications
Modifications.NotPriced: Turn on Auto Price to include modifications in the price.
Modifications.Name: Name
Modifications.EnhancementHint: Counts as this much extra enhancement bonus when pricing, like +1 for keen.
Modifications.PriceHint: Flat cost added to the price.

Price.OverLimit: Total enhancement exceeds +10, which has no listed price.
